meta.name: pandas-pro
meta.description: Performs pandas DataFrame operations for data analysis, manipulation, and transformation. Use when working with pandas DataFrames, data cleaning, aggregation, merging, or time series analysis. Invoke for data manipulation tasks such as joining DataFrames on multiple keys, pivoting tables, resampling time series, handling NaN values with interpolation or forward-fill, groupby aggregations, type conversion, or performance optimization of large datasets.

copy.tagline: 用 pandas 清洗、转换和分析数据
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常用 Python 处理表格数据、做统计分析
copy.tagline_en: Clean, transform, and analyze data with pandas
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often work with tabular data and statistical analysis in Python

howto.what: 装了这个技能后，Claude 会像数据处理专家一样操作表格：用批量计算代替逐行循环，自动设置合适的数据类型、检查内存占用和缺失值，并在转换后验证数据质量，最终提供带注释的代码和性能建议。
howto.when: 当你涉及 pandas 的 DataFrame、数据清洗、聚合等表格操作时触发。

say.text: 用 pandas 把这个 CSV 按多列合并成一张表
say.note: Claude 会按 pandas 规范写合并代码并验证行数

say.text: 把这份时间序列数据按天重采样并求和
say.note: Claude 会生成重采样代码并处理缺失值

say.text: 帮我优化这段 pandas 代码，减少内存占用
say.note: Claude 会检查内存并给出优化建议

howto.what_en: With this skill, Claude works on tables like a data expert: bulk ops instead of loops, sets dtypes, checks memory and missing values, validates results, and provides annotated code with performance tips.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you work with pandas DataFrames, data cleaning, aggregation, or similar table operations.

say_en.text: Use pandas to merge this CSV into one table on multiple columns.
say_en.note: Claude will write the merge code and validate row counts.

say_en.text: Resample this time series by day and sum the values.
say_en.note: Claude will generate the resampling and handle NaN values.

say_en.text: Help me optimize this pandas code to reduce memory usage.
say_en.note: Claude will check memory and suggest optimizations.
